# Evolvora Technologies Software Company in Lahore, Pakistan

We're a **software company in Lahore** that designs and builds custom **web, mobile and cloud** software for businesses in Pakistan, and runs its own products. **[Evolvora Campus](https://evolvoratech.com/products/evolvora-campus/)**, our [school management system](https://evolvoratech.com/school-management-system/), runs fees, attendance, payroll and parent updates for Pakistani schools, with alerts on WhatsApp and SMS and fee payments through JazzCash and EasyPaisa.

[Book a free demo](https://evolvoratech.com/contact/) [Custom software projects](https://evolvoratech.com/services/)

**Custom builds**web · mobile · cloud

What makes us different: **assign us the work, take that long vacation, and we handle it all.**

## A software company in Lahore that runs its own products

Evolvora Technologies builds software for businesses, startups and schools in Pakistan. We are a remote team based in Lahore, working in English and Urdu, and every project is built by the same people who build and support our own products. That is why we know what it takes to keep software running after launch: payments that reconcile, messages that reach parents, and updates that do not break anything.

# Evolvora Campus | School Software Made for Pakistan

> Evolvora Campus runs fees, attendance, payroll and WhatsApp and SMS parent alerts for schools in Pakistan, in one platform. See features, plans and how it works.

Source: https://evolvoratech.com/products/evolvora-campus/

Made in Lahore for Pakistani schools

# Evolvora Campus  
runs your whole school.

It brings your office, teachers and parents together in one place so fees get collected on time, salaries calculate themselves, teachers reach class on schedule, and parents always stay in the loop.

[Book a free demo](https://evolvoratech.com/contact/) See how it works

**3-in-1**Admin · Teacher · Parent

**Minutes**to onboard a whole class

**Instant**updates to parents' phones

_app.evolvoratech.com_

[Image: Evolvora Campus dashboard showing student numbers, school attendance trend, fee submission status and new admissions]

Everything a growing school juggles by hand (**students, staff, fees, attendance, results and messages**) is handled in one connected system. Built for Pakistan: **fee reminders on WhatsApp and SMS**, **fee payments through JazzCash and EasyPaisa**, and [pricing in rupees](https://evolvoratech.com/products/evolvora-campus/pricing/).

Why schools switch

## Less paperwork. Fewer phone calls.  
More time to teach.

Evolvora Campus takes the four things that eat up your week and makes them effortless.

### Fee collection made easy

See exactly who has paid, who is pending and what's outstanding: the whole school in one view. Send fee reminders in a tap instead of chasing parents.

### Salaries that calculate themselves

Basic pay, allowances and tax status are stored per teacher, so monthly salary is worked out automatically. No spreadsheets, no manual maths, no mistakes.

### Teachers reach class on time

Attendance is marked from the classroom in seconds, with a clear daily schedule. Teachers know exactly where they're needed: punctual classes, every day.

### Parents notified instantly

Marks, attendance, fee reminders and daily diary reach parents the moment they happen, on the app and their phone. Every family stays informed, automatically.

# SilaaiMarkaz: Tailoring Marketplace in Lahore | Evolvora

> SilaaiMarkaz, by Evolvora, is a tailoring marketplace in Lahore. Compare Darzis, save your measurements, agree the price upfront, then visit the shop.

Source: https://evolvoratech.com/products/silaaimarkaz/

[Home](https://evolvoratech.com/)/[Products](https://evolvoratech.com/products/)/SilaaiMarkaz

Our product · Live in Lahore

# SilaaiMarkaz  
Lahore's tailoring marketplace

**SilaaiMarkaz** helps you find the right tailor in Lahore. Compare shops, save your measurements, share the design and agree the price, then visit the shop when the work is ready.

[Find a Darzi](https://app.silaaimarkaz.com/auth/login)[Download for Android](https://silaaimarkaz.com/downloads/silaaimarkaz.apk)

_silaaimarkaz.com_

[Image: How SilaaiMarkaz works: price agreed before work starts, measurements stay with you, you visit the shop, Darzis are rated and accountable]

## What is SilaaiMarkaz?

**SilaaiMarkaz** (also written Silaai Markaz or Silai Markaz) is a tailoring marketplace: a place where people who want clothes stitched meet the tailors, or Darzis, who stitch them. If you are looking for a tailor in Lahore, for ladies suits, bridal wear, men's shalwar kameez or simple alterations, it lets you compare shops before you visit one. It fixes the parts of getting clothes made that usually go wrong, like the price changing at the shop, measurements taken again every time, and designs lost in a chat thread.

SilaaiMarkaz is built and run by [Evolvora Technologies](https://evolvoratech.com/about/), the Lahore software house behind [Evolvora Campus](https://evolvoratech.com/products/evolvora-campus/). It works on Android and on the web at [silaaimarkaz.com](https://silaaimarkaz.com/), in English and Urdu.

How it works

## From choosing a Darzi to collecting your clothes

1

### Pick a Darzi

Portfolios, prices and turnaround, side by side.

→

2

### Send measurements

Save a profile once; every later order takes ten seconds.

→

3

### Share the design

Reference photos and notes go straight to the Darzi.

→

4

### Visit the shop

When it's ready you go to the shop, and pay there if you choose.

Why SilaaiMarkaz

## The part that usually goes wrong, fixed

### Ratings before you choose

See ratings and reviews of each Darzi before you place an order.

### Price agreed upfront

The price is agreed before work starts. No surprise charges at the shop.

### Measurements stay with you

Saved measurement profiles work with any Darzi on the platform.

### You visit the shop

Drop-off, fittings and collection happen at the Darzi's own shop in Lahore.

## For Darzis: grow your tailoring shop

Put your work in front of customers who are already looking, take orders with measurements attached, and get paid without chasing anyone.

-   **Get found:** your portfolio, prices and turnaround are shown to customers searching in Lahore.
-   **Clear orders:** measurements, reference photos and notes arrive with every order.
-   **Price settled first:** the price is agreed before you start, so there is no haggling at the counter.

[Register your shop](https://app.silaaimarkaz.com/auth/darzi/signup)

FAQ

## SilaaiMarkaz: common questions

SilaaiMarkaz (also written Silaai Markaz or Silai Markaz) is a tailoring marketplace built by Evolvora Technologies. You compare tailors (Darzis) in Lahore, save your measurements, share your design and agree the price in the app, then visit the shop when the work is ready.

SilaaiMarkaz is opening with tailors (Darzis) in Lahore. Shops appear in the app as they are listed.

No. You visit the Darzi's shop yourself for fabric drop-off, fittings and collection. SilaaiMarkaz handles finding the right Darzi, the measurements, the design details and the agreed price.

Each Darzi sets their own rates. The price is agreed in the app before work starts, so there is no surprise number at the shop, and you can choose to pay at the shop.

Yes. There is an Android app you can download from silaaimarkaz.com, and you can also find a Darzi on the website and continue on your phone. The app is available in English and Urdu.

Register your shop on the SilaaiMarkaz Darzi sign-up page at app.silaaimarkaz.com. Your work is shown to customers who are already looking, and orders arrive with measurements attached.

Order from the app, or find a Darzi on silaaimarkaz.com and continue on your phone.

# Evolvora Campus Pricing: Plans from Rs 50 per Student

> Evolvora Campus pricing in rupees or dollars: Standard at Rs 50 per student per month with a free first month, and Enterprise for multi-campus school networks.

Source: https://evolvoratech.com/products/evolvora-campus/pricing/

[Home](https://evolvoratech.com/)/[Products](https://evolvoratech.com/products/)/[Evolvora Campus](https://evolvoratech.com/products/evolvora-campus/)/Pricing

Pricing

# Simple pricing for every school

Two plans, both charged per active student per month, with unlimited teacher and parent accounts. Start with a free month on Standard, or talk to us about Enterprise for a network of campuses.

[Start your free month](https://evolvoratech.com/contact/)[Book a demo](https://evolvoratech.com/contact/)

1 month free

### Standard

Every feature, for schools of any size.

Rs 50/student / mo

Billed monthly · no setup fee · no minimum

-   Students, classes & sections
-   Attendance & marks
-   Fee tracking, with reminders on WhatsApp & SMS
-   Fee payments through JazzCash & EasyPaisa
-   Parent app & notifications
-   Teacher payroll & salary calculation
-   Bulk import & auto parent accounts
-   Groups, read receipts & web push
-   Multi-campus support
-   Unlimited teacher & parent accounts
-   Onboarding, data import & support

[Start your free month](https://evolvoratech.com/contact/)

### Enterprise

For school networks with several campuses.

Rs 75/student / mo

Minimum Rs 49,900 a month · 10% off billed yearly

-   **Everything in Standard**
-   Head-office view across every campus
-   A dedicated account manager
-   On-site staff training at every campus
-   Priority support on WhatsApp & phone
-   99.5% uptime commitment, in writing
-   Data migration for each campus: Rs 49,900 one-time per campus, waived on yearly billing

[Talk to us about Enterprise](https://evolvoratech.com/contact/)

Only active students are billed. No per-parent charge, no long-term contract. Prices are set in US dollars; rupee prices are converted at USD 1 = PKR 277.11 (28 September 2026).

Questions

## Pricing FAQ

There are two plans, both charged per active student per month. Standard is Rs 50 (USD 0.18) with every feature included. Enterprise is Rs 75 (USD 0.27) for school networks with several campuses, and adds a dedicated account manager, on-site training and priority support. You only pay for students who are actually active in the system.

Most single schools choose Standard: it has every feature, including multi-campus support, with no setup fee and no minimum. Enterprise suits school networks that want a named account manager, training at every campus, priority support on WhatsApp and phone, and a written 99.5% uptime commitment. It has a monthly minimum of Rs 49,900 (USD 180).

Yes. Every school on the Standard plan starts with a full month free, with all features unlocked. You're not charged anything until the trial ends, and there's no card required to begin.

Prices are set in US dollars and converted to rupees at USD 1 = PKR 277.11 (28 September 2026), so you can compare them easily. Use the switch at the top of the page to change currency.

No. Both plans are billed monthly and you can adjust as your school grows. Enterprise schools can choose yearly billing for 10% off, but it is never required.

Yes. On Standard, our team helps you import students, classes and staff, including bulk import from an Excel file. On Enterprise, onboarding covers data migration and on-site training for each campus, for a one-time Rs 49,900 (USD 180) per campus, waived on yearly billing.

Yes. Teacher and parent access is included in both plans at no extra per-user cost. You're billed at the school level, not per parent.

## Standard or Enterprise? We'll help you choose

Tell us how many students and campuses you have, and we'll recommend a plan and send a clear quote.

Careers

# Work at Evolvora

We're a small software company in Lahore that builds and runs its own products, [Evolvora Campus](https://evolvoratech.com/products/evolvora-campus/) and [SilaaiMarkaz](https://evolvoratech.com/products/silaaimarkaz/), and builds software for clients. Your work reaches real schools, parents and businesses quickly.

## Open positions

### .NET + Angular Developer

Build features across Evolvora Campus and client projects, from Angular screens to .NET APIs and PostgreSQL.

Apply now

-   Remote (Pakistan)
-   Full-time
-   Experience: 1 year or more

Role details

#### What you will do

-   Build and maintain web applications with Angular and TypeScript on the front end and ASP.NET Core (C#) on the back end.
-   Design REST APIs and work with PostgreSQL databases.
-   Ship features for Evolvora Campus, our school management system, and for client projects.
-   Write clean, tested code, and review code with the rest of the team.

# Privacy Policy | Evolvora Technologies

> How Evolvora Technologies handles the information you send through evolvoratech.com: contact enquiries, job applications and browser preferences.

Source: https://evolvoratech.com/privacy/

[Home](https://evolvoratech.com/)/Privacy policy

# Privacy policy

Last updated 11 October 2026

This policy explains what information Evolvora Technologies ("we") collects through this website, evolvoratech.com, and what we do with it. It does not cover Evolvora Campus or SilaaiMarkaz, which have their own terms for the data schools, parents, customers and tailors store in them.

## Who we are

Evolvora Technologies is a software company based in Lahore, Pakistan, working as a remote team. You can contact us about privacy at [contact@evolvoratech.com](mailto:contact@evolvoratech.com) or on [+92 314 0163628](tel:+923140163628).

## What we collect

-   **Contact form:** your name, email, organisation, approximate number of students and your message.
-   **Careers form:** the position, your name, email, phone, city, years of experience, any profile link you give, your CV and your message.
-   **Emails and calls:** whatever you choose to send us.

We do not use advertising or analytics cookies, and this website does not track you across other sites.

## How we use it

-   To reply to your enquiry, arrange a demo or discovery call, and send a quote you asked for.
-   To assess job applications and contact candidates.
-   To keep records of our conversations with clients.

We do not sell your information, and we do not add you to marketing lists without asking.

## Who processes it

This website is hosted by Netlify, which also receives and stores form submissions, including uploaded CVs, on our behalf. Submissions are then emailed to our team. We share information with no one else unless the law requires it.

## How long we keep it

-   **Enquiries:** for as long as we are in contact with you, and then as long as reasonably needed for our records.
-   **Job applications:** until the hiring decision, and for up to 6 months afterwards in case a similar role opens. Ask us and we will delete yours sooner.

## Preferences stored in your browser

The site remembers two choices in your browser's local storage: light or dark theme, and whether prices are shown in rupees or dollars. They stay on your device, are never sent to us, and you can clear them in your browser settings.

## Your choices

You can ask us what information we hold about you, ask us to correct it, or ask us to delete it, by emailing [contact@evolvoratech.com](mailto:contact@evolvoratech.com). We will reply within 30 days.

## Changes

If we change this policy, we will update it on this page and change the date at the top.

School Management System

# A school management system that does it all

Evolvora Campus is a modern **school management system** that brings admissions, attendance, marks, fee collection, teacher payroll and parent communication into one simple platform so your whole school runs from a single screen.

[Book a free demo](https://evolvoratech.com/contact/)[Explore the platform](https://evolvoratech.com/products/evolvora-campus/)

_Evolvora Campus_

[Image: School management system dashboard in Evolvora Campus]

## What is a school management system?

A **school management system** is software that replaces the scattered registers, spreadsheets and message groups a school uses day to day. Instead of tracking attendance in one place, fees in another and results somewhere else, everything lives in one connected system that admins, teachers and parents can all access.

Evolvora Campus was built for real schools. Set it up once (your classes, sections, staff and students) and information flows automatically. Teachers record attendance and marks from the classroom, the office tracks fees and salaries, and parents are notified instantly on their phones.

Capabilities

## Everything a school management system should cover

### Student & class records

Every student, class and section in one searchable place. Add them individually or import a whole class from Excel.

### Attendance tracking

Mark a full class present, late or absent in seconds, with live totals and trends.

### Fee management

See paid, pending and outstanding fees at a glance and send reminders in a tap.

### Staff & payroll

Store pay, allowances and tax status per teacher, and salaries calculate automatically.

## Why schools move from registers and spreadsheets to Evolvora Campus

-   **All-in-one:** attendance, marks, fees, payroll and messaging in a single system, with no more disconnected tools.
-   **Made for everyone:** tailored views for admins, teachers and parents, with no training required.
-   **Mobile-ready:** parents get instant updates on their phones; teachers work from the classroom.
-   **Fast to launch:** bulk-import students and auto-create parent logins in minutes.

## Built for schools in Pakistan

-   **WhatsApp and SMS alerts:** fee reminders, attendance and announcements reach parents on the apps they already use.
-   **JazzCash and EasyPaisa:** parents can pay school fees online from their phones.
-   **Priced in rupees:** Rs 50 per active student per month, with a free first month. [See pricing](https://evolvoratech.com/products/evolvora-campus/pricing/).
-   **Support from Lahore:** call [+92 314 0163628](tel:+923140163628) or email [contact@evolvoratech.com](mailto:contact@evolvoratech.com), in English or Urdu.

[Book a demo](https://evolvoratech.com/contact/) [See pricing](https://evolvoratech.com/products/evolvora-campus/pricing/)

FAQ

It centralises the daily running of a school (student records, attendance, marks, fee collection, staff and payroll, and parent communication) into one platform so information is entered once and shared automatically with everyone who needs it.

Yes. Evolvora Campus scales from small schools to large multi-section campuses. You only pay for the active students you have, and teacher and parent access is always included.

# Multi-Campus School Management Software | Evolvora Campus

Source: https://evolvoratech.com/campus-management-system/

Multi-Campus School Management

# Multi-campus school management  
for schools with more than one branch

Evolvora Campus is **multi-campus school management software** for school networks with several campuses or branches. Every campus keeps its own classes, staff and fee records, while head office sees the whole network in one live picture.

[Book a free demo](https://evolvoratech.com/contact/)[Explore the platform](https://evolvoratech.com/products/evolvora-campus/)

_Evolvora Campus_

[Image: Multi-campus school management dashboard in Evolvora Campus]

## What is multi-campus school management software?

**Multi-campus school management software** runs a group of schools from one system: enrolment, classes and sections, attendance, fees, staff and payroll, and parent communication for every branch. What separates it from a single-school system is control: each campus runs day to day on its own, while head office can see the totals and compare branches.

Evolvora Campus is structured for exactly that. Each campus keeps its own sections, staff directory and fee ledger, so a teacher only sees their own classes and a branch head only sees their branch, while head office gets one consolidated view across every campus. Networks that want a dedicated account manager and training at every campus can choose the [Enterprise plan](https://evolvoratech.com/products/evolvora-campus/pricing/).

Evolvora Campus is built for schools, not universities. For a single-site school, our [school management system](https://evolvoratech.com/school-management-system/) page is the better starting point.

Capabilities

## What school networks get with Evolvora Campus

### Every branch, one system

Each campus keeps its own classes, sections, staff and fees, all inside one account.

### Access by role

Teachers see their own classes, branch heads their own campus, and head office sees them all.

### Network-wide messaging

Reach a class, a campus or every parent in the network in one message, with read receipts.

### Head-office view

Attendance, fee collection and outstanding dues for every campus, side by side on one dashboard.

## Why school networks pick Evolvora Campus

-   **Built for branches:** each campus runs on its own, and head office sees every one.
-   **One source of truth:** admins, teachers and parents across the network share the same live data.
-   **Instant communication:** announcements and alerts reach the right campus immediately.
-   **Simple to run:** a clean, modern interface that staff at every branch pick up on day one.

## Built for schools in Pakistan

-   **An Enterprise plan for networks:** Rs 75 per active student per month, with a dedicated account manager and on-site training at every campus. [Compare plans](https://evolvoratech.com/products/evolvora-campus/pricing/).
-   **WhatsApp and SMS alerts:** fee reminders, attendance and announcements reach parents on the apps they already use.
-   **JazzCash and EasyPaisa:** parents can pay school fees online from their phones.
-   **Priced in rupees:** Rs 50 per active student per month, with a free first month. [See pricing](https://evolvoratech.com/products/evolvora-campus/pricing/).
-   **Support from Lahore:** call [+92 314 0163628](tel:+923140163628) or email [contact@evolvoratech.com](mailto:contact@evolvoratech.com), in English or Urdu.

Yes. Access is role-based: teachers see their own classes, branch heads see their own campus, and head office sees every campus in one view.

Yes. The Standard plan (Rs 50 per active student per month) already includes multi-campus support. Source: https://evolvoratech.com/school-erp/

School ERP

# School ERP software  
for finance, HR and payroll

Evolvora Campus is modern **school ERP software** for the back office: staff records, automatic teacher payroll, a full fee ledger and finance reporting, all sharing one set of student data instead of living in separate spreadsheets.

[Book a free demo](https://evolvoratech.com/contact/)[Explore the platform](https://evolvoratech.com/products/evolvora-campus/)

_Evolvora Campus_

[Image: School ERP staff and payroll module in Evolvora Campus]

## What is school ERP software?

**School ERP** (Enterprise Resource Planning) software is the administrative and financial backbone of a school: staff and HR records, payroll, fee collection and the finance ledger, all reading from the same student information. The distinction from day-to-day academic tools is where the weight sits. An ERP is judged on whether the money and the staff records are right.

Traditional school ERPs are powerful but painful to use. Evolvora Campus delivers the same connected control (including automatic teacher salary calculation and a full fee ledger) in a clean, modern interface your staff will actually enjoy using.

_Evolvora Campus · Expenses_

[Image: School expense tracker in Evolvora Campus showing this month's total of Rs. 984,000, an expense trend chart and expenses by category, with salaries the largest at 81%]

The daily expense tracker: every school expense by category (salaries, bills, repairs, furniture, stationery), with monthly totals, a trend chart and recurring expenses.

Capabilities

## The back-office modules you get

### Student information

A complete, searchable record for every student, class and section.

### HR & payroll

Staff records with basic pay, allowances and tax status, and salaries are calculated automatically.

### Finance & fees

Track dues, collect fees and see your whole-school fee position in real time.

### One secure system

Role-based access for admins, teachers and parents. Everyone sees exactly what they should.

## Why schools replace a legacy ERP with Evolvora Campus

-   **Truly integrated:** academics, HR, finance and communication share one database.
-   **Modern & usable:** none of the clutter of legacy ERP software.
-   **Automated payroll:** teacher salaries computed from stored pay and tax settings.
-   **Expense tracking:** record daily school expenses by category and payment method, and see monthly totals and trends at a glance.
-   **Grows with you:** from a single school to multiple campuses.

## Built for schools in Pakistan

-   **WhatsApp and SMS alerts:** fee reminders, attendance and announcements reach parents on the apps they already use.
-   **JazzCash and EasyPaisa:** parents can pay school fees online from their phones.
-   **Priced in rupees:** Rs 50 per active student per month, with a free first month. [See pricing](https://evolvoratech.com/products/evolvora-campus/pricing/).
-   **Support from Lahore:** call [+92 314 0163628](tel:+923140163628) or email [contact@evolvoratech.com](mailto:contact@evolvoratech.com), in English or Urdu.

[Book a demo](https://evolvoratech.com/contact/) [See pricing](https://evolvoratech.com/products/evolvora-campus/pricing/)

A school ERP is software that integrates the core functions of running a school (student records, staff and payroll, attendance, fees and finance, and communication) into one connected system, replacing disconnected spreadsheets and tools.

Yes. You store each teacher's basic pay, allowances and tax status, and monthly salary is calculated automatically, with no separate payroll spreadsheet needed.

# Student attendance software

## What is student attendance software?

**Student attendance software** replaces paper registers with a digital system for recording who is present, late or absent each day. Good attendance software is quick for teachers, accurate for the office, and transparent for parents.

In Evolvora Campus, a teacher opens their class, taps **Present, Late or Absent** for each student (or marks everyone present and flags the exceptions), and totals update live. Attendance feeds straight into dashboards and the parent app, so families and administrators always have the real picture.

### Mark in seconds

### Instant parent alerts

Parents can be told about their child's attendance automatically, in the app and on WhatsApp and SMS.

### Per-student history

Every child has a clear attendance record parents can view anytime.

## Why teachers keep using it after the first week

-   **Genuinely fast:** a full class marked in under a minute.
-   **Accurate records:** no lost registers, no double entry.
-   **Parents in the loop:** attendance shows up in the parent app instantly.
-   **Part of the whole:** attendance connects to dashboards, marks and reports.

School Fee Management Software

# School fee management software  
that ends the chasing

2026 list & buyer's guide

# Software companies in Lahore: a 2026 list and buyer's guide

By [Sheharyar Khan](https://evolvoratech.com/about/), founder of Evolvora Technologies · Published 11 October 2026 · Updated 11 October 2026

Lahore has hundreds of software companies, from Systems Limited, founded here in 1977, to small teams that run their own products. The right **software company in Lahore** for you is one that has shipped and still runs real software for Pakistani users, can show you its payment and integration work live, quotes in rupees after a proper discovery phase, and will still be supporting you two years after launch. Below is a short list of well-known Lahore firms and what each is known for, then the checks to run before you sign with any of them.

In short

-   Ask to see software the company **runs itself**, not only screenshots of client work.
-   For anything that takes money, insist on a **live JazzCash, EasyPaisa or card integration** you can try.
-   Schools with several branches should test **multi-campus** handling: separate data per campus, one head-office view.
-   Expect a discovery phase, weekly demos, code and hosting in **your name**, and support terms in writing.
-   A first version of a custom web app typically takes **2 to 4 months** and costs **Rs 1.5 to 5 million**.

## Why hire a software company in Lahore?

Hiring locally is about more than time zones. A software company in Lahore can sit in your office for a requirements workshop, train your staff in Urdu, and already knows how Pakistani customers pay, which phones they use and how patchy mobile data can be outside the big cities. Contracts and invoices are in rupees, and problems can be solved face to face.

Lahore also has a deep pool of engineers, from the [Arfa Software Technology Park](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Arfa_Software_Technology_Park) to the many software houses around Johar Town, Gulberg and DHA. That choice is the problem: hundreds of firms describe themselves the same way. The rest of this guide is about telling them apart.

Compared with a freelancer, a company gives you continuity: if one developer leaves, the knowledge and the code stay with a team. Compared with an overseas agency, you usually pay less, get support in your own hours, and work with people who understand local requirements without having them explained.

## Software companies in Lahore: who does what

This is not a ranking. It is a starting shortlist of well-known software companies (in Pakistan often called software houses) with large teams or offices in Lahore, with what each is publicly known for, so you can match a firm to the size and type of your project. It is published by Evolvora Technologies, which is included at the end. Details come from each company's own website and public sources as of October 2026; check them directly before you decide.

The big names suit large, long programmes with big budgets. Small and mid-sized Pakistani businesses and schools often get more attention, faster decisions and lower prices from a smaller firm, as long as it passes the checks below. Whoever you shortlist, compare them on the same questions rather than on who appears in a "top 10" list: many of those lists, including this one, are written by software companies.

## Which services should it offer?

Most projects need more than one discipline. A capable software company should cover these in-house, or tell you plainly which parts it subcontracts.

### Custom web applications

Dashboards, portals and internal tools built around your workflow. Ask how they structure the code so another team could maintain it, and whether they write automated tests.

### Mobile apps

Most Pakistani users are on Android, often on mid-range phones. Ask whether the app works on a slow connection, how large the download is, and whether they have published to the Google Play Store and Apple App Store under a client's own account.

### SaaS product engineering

If you are selling software to many customers, you need multi-tenant architecture (each customer's data kept separate inside one system), subscription billing, and role-based access. This is very different from a one-off website, so ask for a SaaS product the company has actually taken to paying customers.

### UI/UX design

Good design starts with research and wireframes, not colours. Ask to see a clickable prototype from a past project, and whether the design handles Urdu text and right-to-left layouts if you need them.

### Cloud and DevOps

Someone has to deploy, monitor, back up and update the software after launch. Ask how they deploy (an automated pipeline, or by hand), how they are alerted when something breaks, and how quickly they can restore from a backup.

Evolvora covers all six areas in-house. See our [software development services](https://evolvoratech.com/services/) for the detail.

## Why its own products matter more than a portfolio

A portfolio shows what a company delivered once. Its own products show what it can keep running. A firm that operates software under its own name deals every day with real users, support requests, payment failures and updates, which is exactly what you need from a long-term partner. Here are the two products Evolvora runs, as an example of what to look for.

Building it meant solving the problems most Pakistani clients bring to a software company:

-   **Local payments:** parents pay fees through JazzCash and EasyPaisa, and the school sees paid, pending and outstanding fees in one place.

## Practical checks before you sign

These checks take an afternoon and save months. Do them before you sign anything.

### 1\. Payment gateway experience

If your software takes money, payments are where projects most often slip. In Pakistan that means mobile wallets (JazzCash, EasyPaisa), cards through a local bank or acquirer, and bank transfers, including [Raast](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Raast), the State Bank of Pakistan's instant payment system. Ask the company:

-   Can I make a real payment in a live system you built?
-   How long did merchant onboarding with the provider take, and who handled it?
-   What happens when a payment succeeds at the bank but the confirmation never reaches the app?
-   How are refunds, partial payments and daily reconciliation handled?

A team that has run payments in production will answer these in detail. A team that has only used a sandbox will talk about the API. Our [JazzCash and EasyPaisa integration guide](https://evolvoratech.com/guides/jazzcash-easypaisa-integration/) explains what a reliable integration involves.

### 2\. Multi-campus school integrations

School networks are a common and demanding client in Lahore. If you run more than one branch, check that the software:

-   keeps each campus's students, staff and fee records separate, so a branch head sees only their branch;
-   gives head office one consolidated view, with totals and comparisons across campuses;
-   allows different fee structures, discounts and timetables per campus;
-   sends messages to one class, one campus or the whole network;
-   imports existing records from Excel instead of retyping them.

These are the problems [Evolvora Campus's multi-campus management](https://evolvoratech.com/campus-management-system/) was built for, so it is a useful benchmark when you compare vendors, or a ready answer if you would rather not build at all.

### 3\. Ownership of code, data and accounts

Your contract should say that you own the source code, and that the domain, hosting, app store and payment accounts are registered in your company's name. Ask for access to the code repository from the first week, not at the end.

### 4\. Security and data handling

Ask where the data is hosted, who on their team can access it, how passwords are stored and how often backups are tested. Student and payment data deserve particular care.

### 5\. Process and visibility

You should see working software every week or two, not a big reveal at the end. Ask for a sample project plan and a sample weekly update.

### 6\. Support after launch, in writing

Get response times, working hours, what counts as a bug versus a new feature, and the monthly cost of support agreed before launch. For example, Evolvora's Enterprise plan for school networks puts a 99.5% uptime commitment in writing.

### 7\. Registration and standing

Check that the company is a registered business and that you can meet the people who will build your software, on a video call or in person. A big office is not proof of quality, and many good teams, Evolvora included, work remotely; what matters is a named team, a written contract and references. Registration with the [Pakistan Software Export Board](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pakistan_Software_Export_Board) or membership of [P@SHA](https://www.pasha.org.pk/) are further signals, but they do not replace the checks above.

## References and client feedback

Testimonials on a website are a starting point. A phone call is better. Ask for two or three clients with projects like yours and ask them three things: did it launch on time and on budget, what went wrong and how was it handled, and are they still working with the company today?

Evolvora is happy to put you in touch with schools that run Evolvora Campus and with the Darzis on SilaaiMarkaz. [Ask us for references](https://evolvoratech.com/contact/) and we will arrange a call.

## Red flags

-   A fixed price for a complex system before anyone has asked how your business works.
-   No live software you can use, only screenshots and mock-ups.
-   The code, hosting or app store account will be in the vendor's name.
-   No written support terms, or support "included" with no hours or response times.
-   You never meet the developers, only a salesperson.
-   Every question is answered with "yes, we can do that" and none with "here is how".

### What a typical engagement looks like

1.  **Discovery (1 to 2 weeks):** workshops with your team, a written scope, a first estimate and the main risks.
2.  **Design (2 to 3 weeks):** wireframes and a clickable prototype you can test with real users before any code is written.
3.  **Build (6 to 12 weeks):** one- or two-week sprints, each ending with a working demo you can try.
4.  **Launch (1 to 2 weeks):** data migration, staff training, go-live and close monitoring.
5.  **Support and growth (ongoing):** fixes, updates and new features under a monthly retainer.

## Checklist: choosing a long-term technology partner

Use this before you sign. A company worth a long partnership should pass all ten.

1.  Runs at least one live product or system you can use yourself.
2.  Has shipped work in your sector, or a problem shaped like yours.
3.  Can demonstrate live JazzCash, EasyPaisa, card or bank integrations if you take payments.
4.  For schools: handles multiple campuses with separate data and a head-office view.
5.  Offers a discovery phase before a fixed price.
6.  Shows you working software every one or two weeks.
7.  Puts code, domain, hosting and app store accounts in your name.
8.  Explains where your data is hosted, who can access it and how backups work.
9.  Agrees support hours, response times and monthly cost in writing.
10.  Gives you references you can call, and lets you meet the actual team, online or in person in Lahore.

# Software Development Cost in Pakistan (2026 Prices)

> What software costs in Pakistan in 2026: websites, web apps, mobile apps and SaaS in rupees, what drives the price, and the running costs quotes leave out.

Source: https://evolvoratech.com/guides/software-development-cost-pakistan/

[Home](https://evolvoratech.com/)/[Guides](https://evolvoratech.com/guides/)/Software development cost in Pakistan

2026 price guide

# Software development cost in Pakistan (2026)

By [Sheharyar Khan](https://evolvoratech.com/about/), founder of Evolvora Technologies · Published 11 October 2026 · Updated 11 October 2026

In 2026, **software development in Pakistan** typically costs Rs 150,000 to 600,000 for a business website, Rs 1.5 to 5 million for the first version of a custom web application, Rs 2 to 6 million for a mobile app on Android and iOS, and Rs 4 million or more for a SaaS product. The biggest price drivers are the number of user roles, the integrations and who maintains the software afterwards.

In short

-   Price follows **scope**: user roles, screens and integrations, more than technology choice.
-   Budget another **15 to 20 percent a year** for maintenance, plus hosting and messaging.
-   Payments, SMS and WhatsApp each add work **and** a running cost.
-   Get a quote only after a short **discovery phase**, and compare quotes on the same written scope.

Contents

1.  What software costs in Pakistan in 2026
2.  What drives the price?
3.  Freelancer, software company or in-house team?
4.  Running costs most quotes leave out
5.  Fixed price or time and materials?
6.  How to get an accurate quote
7.  Build or buy? A school example

## What software costs in Pakistan in 2026

These are typical ranges for Pakistani clients working with a software company in 2026. They are the same bands we use in our [guide to software companies in Lahore](https://evolvoratech.com/guides/software-company-lahore/), and they assume a small team: a designer, two or three developers, testing and a project lead.

Engagement

Quotes far below these ranges usually mean a template with your logo on it, a single freelancer, or a scope that leaves out testing, deployment and support. Quotes far above usually come from firms set up for large international clients.

## What drives the price?

### 1\. User roles and screens

Every type of user (customer, staff, manager, admin) needs its own screens and permissions. A system with one role is far cheaper than one with four. Evolvora Campus, for example, has separate views for admins, teachers and parents, and each one is a product in its own right.

### 2\. Integrations

Connecting to other systems is where estimates most often slip: [JazzCash and EasyPaisa payments](https://evolvoratech.com/guides/jazzcash-easypaisa-integration/), bank transfers, SMS and WhatsApp messaging, accounting software or an existing database. Each integration needs its own testing and error handling.

### 3\. Platforms

A web app that works well on phones is the cheapest way to reach most users. Separate Android and iOS apps cost more, although a cross-platform framework keeps that to one codebase. Decide early which you really need.

### 4\. Design depth

A simple, clean interface built from a design system costs far less than custom illustrations and animation. For most business software, clarity matters more than decoration.

### 5\. Data migration

Moving records from spreadsheets or an old system takes real effort, especially when the data is messy. Ask whether it is included in the quote.

### 6\. Who maintains it afterwards

Software needs updates, security fixes and small changes for as long as you use it. A quote that ends at launch is only part of the cost.

## Freelancer, software company or in-house team?

The same project can be priced very differently depending on who builds it.

-   **Freelancer:** the lowest price, best for small, well-defined jobs. The risk is continuity: if they become busy or unavailable, the knowledge leaves with them.
-   **Software company:** costs more, because the price includes design, testing, project management and a team that stays after launch.
-   **In-house team:** makes sense once software is core to your business and there is enough work to keep developers busy all year. Developer salaries in Pakistan are rising quickly; see [Emerhub's salary overview](https://emerhub.com/pakistan/how-much-does-it-cost-to-hire-software-developers-in-pakistan/) for current ranges, then add recruitment, equipment and management time.

## Running costs most quotes leave out

These costs continue every month or year after launch. Ask for them in writing with the quote.

-   **Hosting and cloud services:** from a few thousand rupees a month for a small app to much more for heavy traffic or large files.
-   **App store accounts:** Google Play charges a one-time USD 25 registration fee; Apple's developer programme costs USD 99 a year.
-   **Messages:** SMS and WhatsApp Business messages are charged per message, which adds up quickly for alerts and reminders.
-   **Payment fees:** wallet, card and bank payments carry a fee per transaction, set by the provider.
-   **Maintenance:** a common rule of thumb is 15 to 20 percent of the build cost each year, or a monthly support retainer.
-   **Domain, email and third-party services:** maps, email delivery, analytics and similar services often have monthly plans.

## Fixed price or time and materials?

**Fixed price** works when the scope is clear and written down, which is why it should follow a discovery phase. It protects your budget, but changes cost extra. **Time and materials** (paying for the hours worked) suits ongoing work where priorities change week to week. A common and fair arrangement is a fixed price for the first version, then a monthly retainer for improvements.

## How to get an accurate quote

1.  **Write a one-page brief:** the problem, who will use the software, and what success looks like.
2.  **List the user roles and the main tasks** each one needs to do.
3.  **List every integration:** payments, messaging, existing systems, data to import.
4.  **Ask for a short discovery phase** before a fixed price. A firm that quotes a complex system without asking questions is guessing.
5.  **Compare like for like:** make sure every quote covers design, testing, deployment, data migration and support, and that the code and accounts will be in your name.

Our [checklist for choosing a software house in Lahore](https://evolvoratech.com/guides/software-company-lahore/) covers what else to ask before you sign.

## Build or buy? A school example

Before paying for custom software, check whether a product already does the job. A school, for example, could spend millions building its own system, or use a [school management system](https://evolvoratech.com/school-management-system/) such as [Evolvora Campus](https://evolvoratech.com/products/evolvora-campus/) at [Rs 50 per active student per month](https://evolvoratech.com/products/evolvora-campus/pricing/), with fees, attendance, payroll and parent alerts already built. A 500-student school pays about Rs 25,000 a month and can start within days. Custom development is the right choice when your process is what makes your business different and no product fits it.

FAQ

## Software development cost: common questions

In 2026, a first version of a custom web application usually costs Rs 1.5 to 5 million, a cross-platform mobile app Rs 2 to 6 million, and a SaaS product Rs 4 to 12 million or more. A business website costs Rs 150,000 to 600,000. The figure depends mostly on the number of user roles, integrations and screens.

Budget roughly 15 to 20 percent of the build cost each year for maintenance, or a monthly retainer of about Rs 100,000 to 500,000 for ongoing fixes, updates and small features. Hosting, app store fees and SMS or WhatsApp messages are extra.

Usually, at the start. A company costs more because the price includes design, testing, project management and someone to call when the developer is unavailable. For anything your business depends on every day, that continuity is usually worth the difference.

Fixed price suits a clearly scoped first version, agreed after a discovery phase. Time and materials suits ongoing work where priorities change. Many projects use both: a fixed price for version one, then a monthly retainer.

# JazzCash & EasyPaisa Integration Guide for Businesses

> How to accept JazzCash and EasyPaisa payments on your website or app: merchant accounts, direct API or aggregator, callbacks, reconciliation and refunds.

Source: https://evolvoratech.com/guides/jazzcash-easypaisa-integration/

[Home](https://evolvoratech.com/)/[Guides](https://evolvoratech.com/guides/)/JazzCash and EasyPaisa integration

Payments guide

# JazzCash and EasyPaisa integration: a guide for businesses

By [Sheharyar Khan](https://evolvoratech.com/about/), founder of Evolvora Technologies · Published 11 October 2026 · Updated 11 October 2026

To accept **JazzCash and EasyPaisa** payments, you open a merchant account with each provider, or one account with an aggregator that covers both, then connect your website or app to their payment API. The part that decides whether it works in real life is on your side: confirming every payment on your own server and reconciling it against your orders each day.

In short

-   Start the **merchant account** applications first: approval can take longer than the development.
-   An **aggregator** gives one integration for wallets, cards and bank transfers, for an extra fee.
-   Never trust the browser or app alone: **verify each payment on your server**.
-   Plan for **missing confirmations, refunds and daily reconciliation** from day one.

Contents

1.  What you need before you start
2.  Direct integration or an aggregator?
3.  How a wallet payment works
4.  The parts that go wrong
5.  Security checklist
6.  How long does integration take?
7.  Example: school fees in Evolvora Campus

## What you need before you start

-   **A merchant account** with JazzCash, EasyPaisa or an aggregator. Each provider sets its own documents; expect business registration details, the owners' identity documents and a business bank account for settlement.
-   **Sandbox (test) credentials** to build against, and later separate live credentials.
-   **A server you control.** Payments must be confirmed by your back end, not only by the website in the customer's browser or by the mobile app.
-   **A clear refund and cancellation policy**, which providers usually expect to see on your site.

Apply for the merchant accounts first. Approval often takes longer than the code.

## Direct integration or an aggregator?

Direct integration

Aggregator

Accounts

One per provider

One

Integration work

A separate API for each provider

One API for wallets, cards and often bank transfers

Fees

The provider's fee only

Provider fee plus the aggregator's

Reports and settlement

One report per provider

One combined report

Best for

High volumes, where fees matter most

Launching quickly with several payment methods

Pakistani aggregators include Safepay, Simpaisa and PayFast. Compare their current fees, settlement times and supported methods directly, as these change.

## How a wallet payment works

The exact screens depend on the provider and the integration type, but a wallet payment generally follows these steps:

1.  The customer chooses JazzCash or EasyPaisa at checkout and enters their mobile account number.
2.  Your server creates the payment with the provider, signed with your merchant credentials.
3.  The customer approves the payment on their phone, for example with their wallet PIN or a one-time code, within a time limit.
4.  The provider sends the result to your server, and usually redirects the customer back to your site or app.
5.  Your server checks the result is genuine and the amount matches the order, then marks it paid and sends a receipt.

## The parts that go wrong

### The confirmation never arrives

Networks fail and customers close the page. If your server has not heard back within a few minutes, it should ask the provider for the payment's status instead of leaving the order as unpaid.

### The same confirmation arrives twice

Providers may resend notifications. Process each payment once, using its transaction reference, so an order is never marked paid twice or a receipt sent twice.

### The customer runs out of time

Wallet approvals expire. Show clear instructions while the customer approves on their phone, and let them retry without creating a duplicate order.

### Refunds

Decide who can issue refunds, how they are recorded against the order, and whether they go through the provider's merchant portal or its API.

### Reconciliation

Every day, match the provider's settlement report against your orders. This catches payments that succeeded but were never recorded, and the reverse, before a customer has to complain.

## Security checklist

-   Keep merchant keys and secrets on your server only, never inside a mobile app or website code.
-   Verify the provider's signature or hash on every result, and check the amount and order reference yourself.
-   Use HTTPS everywhere, and log every payment request and response for disputes.
-   Keep test and live credentials separate, and switch only after a full test with real small payments.

## How long does integration take?

Once merchant accounts are approved, an experienced developer can usually build a clean integration for one or two methods in one to three weeks, including testing with real small payments. Merchant approval itself depends on the provider and on how complete your documents are, so start it first. For a sense of the wider project cost, see our [software development cost guide](https://evolvoratech.com/guides/software-development-cost-pakistan/).

## Example: school fees in Evolvora Campus

In [Evolvora Campus](https://evolvoratech.com/products/evolvora-campus/), our [school fee management software](https://evolvoratech.com/school-fee-management-software/), parents pay school fees through JazzCash and EasyPaisa from their phones, and the school sees paid, pending and outstanding fees for every student in one place. Fee reminders go out on WhatsApp and SMS. It is the kind of payment work worth asking any software company to show you running live, as our [guide to choosing a software company in Lahore](https://evolvoratech.com/guides/software-company-lahore/) recommends.

FAQ

## JazzCash and EasyPaisa integration: common questions

Open a merchant account with each provider, or one account with a payment aggregator that covers both. Then integrate their payment API or hosted checkout, verify every payment on your own server, and reconcile payments against orders each day. A developer experienced with both usually needs one to three weeks once the merchant accounts are approved.

Direct integration avoids an extra fee but means two separate accounts, APIs and settlement reports. An aggregator gives one integration for wallets, cards and bank transfers, and is faster to launch, in exchange for its own fee. For most small and mid-sized businesses an aggregator is the quicker start.

Requirements are set by each provider and change over time, but expect to provide business registration details, the owners' identity documents and a business bank account for settlement. Check the current list with the provider before you start development.

Usually because the provider's confirmation never reached your server, or arrived after the customer left. A reliable integration checks the payment status with the provider when no confirmation arrives, and reconciles against the daily settlement report.
